rows.28:5bd8:
"...All right. I'll come now."
Even if I turned him down here, Hosoda would surely {f:keep|keep} pestering {f:me|me} to come.
Left with no choice, {f:I|I} gave him that answer.
"Thank you!
Thank you, {a}{f:|}!
I just knew you'd say that!
Well then, I'll be waiting at the school gate an hour from now. See you there!"
"Ah, wait a minu..."{p}
rows.28:9444:
Beneath it was an air-raid shelter.
A small one, only big enough for five or six people at most.
Maybe nobody ever seriously meant to use it.
Even at thirty to a class, by the numbers five out of six wouldn't make it.
Apparently there was a proper shelter for the students somewhere else.
So even though it was wartime, it had never actually been used.
Yes... not until that day......{p}
rows.28:95d4:
During the war, there were apparently air raids around here quite often too.
What did people do at times like that, you ask?
There was nothing they could do.
The enemy was in airplanes.
All they could do was hide in a shelter and wait for them to pass.{p}
